turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Why am I here, and why was my son's mark changed before anyone called me?
Look, I'll own it if I messed up.
Then say what you did, and when. Before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Walk me through exactly what I did wrong with Owen's case. Step by step.
I'm not here to build your case for you. You tell me what you did.
